source: GS1 web vocabulary, scoped to what the OpenEPCIS catalog stores

fields.label: GTIN
fields.definition: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin  for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: The GTIN identifies the model. It is stated explicitly rather than left to be read out of a SKU, because everything downstream — the Digital Link, the resolver, the passport itself — is keyed on it.

fields.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
fields.definition: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.
fields.tier_rationale: The lot. Class data describes the model; a lot is where a passport stops being the same for every item.

fields.label: Has Additional Product Classification
fields.definition: Relates to a set of additional product classification details
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Additional Product Description
fields.definition: Additional variants necessary to communicate to the industry to help define the product. Multiple variants can be established for each GTIN for e.g. Style, Colour, and Fragrance .
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Additive
fields.definition: Relates to details about any additives that a product may contain.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Audio File
fields.definition: Link to a file containing an audio clip which is relevant to the product. Examples are commercials, or instructional/ how to use audio files.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Authenticity Details
fields.definition: Links to details of covert/overt security markings that may be used to check authenticity of a product instance.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Award Prize
fields.definition: An award or prize given to the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Best Before Date
fields.definition: Best before date on the label or package signifies the end of the period under which the product will retain specific quality attributes or claims even though the product may continue to retain positive quality attributes after this date. Best before date is primarily used for consumer information and may be a regulatory requirement.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Brand
fields.definition: The brand of the product that appears on the consumer package.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Brand Owner
fields.definition: The brand owner of the product. The organization that is responsible for allocating the GTIN to the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Certification
fields.definition: Certification information about a product, organisation or location.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Colour Code
fields.definition: Relates to a set of details about the colour code for a product
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Colour Description
fields.definition: A description of the colour of an object.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Consumer Handling Storage
fields.definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the manufacturer's recommendations for how the consumer or end user should store and handle the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Consumer Package Disclaimer
fields.definition: Additional information that should be used in advertising and in displaying.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Consumer Product Variant
fields.definition: The consumer product variant may be used to distinguish one variant of a retail consumer trade item from another if the change does not require the allocation of a different Global Trade Item Number (per the GTIN Management Standard), but communication between trading partners is required to support consumers. The brand owner is responsible for assigning the consumer product variant.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Consumer Safety Information
fields.definition: Information on consumer safety regarding the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Consumer Storage Instructions
fields.definition: Expresses in text the consumer storage instructions of a product which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Consumer Usage Instructions
fields.definition: Free text containing the usage instructions of a product, which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Country Of Assembly
fields.definition: The place where product is assembled.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Country Of Last Processing
fields.definition: The place where the product or ingredient was last processed and tested before importation.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Country Of Origin
fields.definition: Code indicating the country of origin of the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Country Of Origin Statement
fields.definition: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Customer Support Centre
fields.definition: The organization which provides product support to the trading partner organization to which merchandise is sold.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Dependent Proprietary Product
fields.definition: Dependent products are products which are required to make the current product functional.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Descriptive Size
fields.definition: An alphanumeric size factor the brand owner wishes to communicate to the consumer. IE Jumbo, Capri, Full Length, Maxi.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Due Date
fields.definition: The date by which an invoice should be paid. This data element represents an attribute of a payment slip reference number, AI (8020), and a Global Location Number (GLN) of the invoicing party.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Equivalent Product
fields.definition: A product which can be substituted for the product based on supplier-defined functional equivalence to the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Expiration Date
fields.definition: The expiration date is the date that determines the limit of consumption or use of a product/coupon. Its meaning is determined based on the trade item context (e.g., for food, the date will indicate the possibility of a direct health risk resulting from use of the product after the date, for pharmaceutical products, it will indicate the possibility of an indirect health risk resulting from the ineffectiveness of the product after the date). It is often referred to as 'use by date' or 'maximum durability date'.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Expiration Date and Time
fields.definition: The manufacturer determines the expiration date and time, which is relevant only for short duration and for items that will not be sent on long distances and not outside of the time zone. A typical application of AI (7003) is in hospitals or public pharmacies for special, customised, products which may have a 'life duration' shorter than one single day. The life duration varies according the pharmaceutical substances used in the treatment. The precise expiration date and time is defined at the end of the manufacturing process, and can be barcoded on the product label as an attribute to the item's GTIN. Where there is no business requirement to express the expiration date to the nearest hour (or less), AI (17) Expiration date should be used.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: First Freeze Date
fields.definition: The first freeze date is applicable to products that are frozen directly after slaughtering, harvesting, catching or after initial processing of the product. Examples include fresh meat, meat products or fishery products. The first freeze date is determined by the organisation conducting the freezing.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Functional Name
fields.definition: Describes use of the product or service by the consumer. Should help clarify the product classification associated with the GTIN.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: GPC Category Code
fields.definition: 8-digit code (GPC Brick Value) specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gpc
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: GPC Category Description
fields.definition: A description of the code specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Gross area
fields.definition: The overall area of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Gross volume
fields.definition: The overall volume of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the volume is measured.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Gross Weight
fields.definition: Used to identify the gross weight of the product. The gross weight includes all packaging materials of the product. At pallet level the productGrossWeight includes the weight of the pallet itself. For example, 200 GRM, value - total pounds, total grams, etc.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Growing Method
fields.definition: The process through which fresh produce is grown and cultivated.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Harvest Date.
fields.definition: The harvest date. For example, the harvest date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This date  is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Harvest Date End
fields.definition: The harvest end date. For example, the harvest end date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This end date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Harvest Date Start
fields.definition: The harvest start date. For example, the harvest start date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This start date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: hasRenderedAccessLevel
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Serial Number
fields.definition: A serial number is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a serial number uniquely identifies an individual item. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of serial numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of serial numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Third-Party Controlled Serial Number
fields.definition: This identifier is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a TPX uniquely identifies an individual item and forms a unit pack Unique Identifier (upUI) for tobacco traceability per EU 2018/574. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The Third Party determines the TPX, but the TPX shall begin with the ID Issuer Unique Identification Code (UIC), followed by GS1 UIC Extension 1, and GS1 UIC Extension 2.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Health Claim
fields.definition: A description of health claims according to regulations of the target market.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: In Package Depth
fields.definition: The depth of the product in its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: In Package Diameter
fields.definition: The measurement of the diameter of the product in its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: In Package Height
fields.definition: The height of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: In Package Width
fields.definition: The width of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Included Accessories
fields.definition: Any included object or device not part of the core product itself but which adds to its functionality or use.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Instructions For Use
fields.definition: Link to a file containing the Instructions For Use.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Is Product Recalled
fields.definition: An indicator for the product to determine if the Manufacturer or Supplier has recalled the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: JSON Web Signature
fields.definition: A link to a JSON Web Signature
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Manufacturer
fields.definition: The organization that produces the item.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Manufacturer's Warranty
fields.definition: The warranty associated with the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Manufacturing Plant
fields.definition: A physical location consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Mass per unit area
fields.definition: The mass per unit area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the mass and area are measured.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Net area
fields.definition: The net area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Net content
fields.definition: The quantity of the product contained by a package, usually as claimed on the label. Indicates the net content of the total product. For fixed value products use the value claimed on the package, to avoid variable fill rate issue that arises with some product which are sold by volume or weight, and whose actual content may vary slightly from batch to batch.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Net weight
fields.definition: Used to identify the net weight of the product. Net Weight excludes all packaging material, including the packaging material of all lower-level GTINs. Example:11.5 kgm.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Organic Claim
fields.definition: Relates to an organic claim about the product
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Out of Package Depth
fields.definition: The depth of the product out of its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Out of Package Diameter
fields.definition: The measurement of the diameter of the product out of its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Out of Package Height
fields.definition: The height of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Out of Package Width
fields.definition: The width of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Packaging
fields.definition: Details on the packaging for a product including type, weight and materials.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Packaging Date
fields.definition: The packaging date is the date when the goods were packed as determined by the packager. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Accreditation Code
fields.definition: A marking that the product received recognition, endorsement, certification by following guidelines by the label issuing agency. This does not represent claims for regulatory purposes on products such as free from markings.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Primary Alternate Product
fields.definition: A product that is similar to the current product but is not exact match. Same form fit function, e.g. same product different colour, different package size, better quality.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Description
fields.definition: An understandable and useable description of a product using brand and other descriptors. This attribute is filled with as little abbreviation as possible, while keeping to a reasonable length.  This should be a meaningful description of the product with full spelling to facilitate message processing. Retailers can use this description as the base to fully understand the brand, flavour, scent etc. of the specific product, in order to accurately create a product description as needed for their internal systems. Examples: XYZ Brand Base Invisible Solid Deodorant AP Stick Spring Breeze.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Feature Benefit
fields.definition: Element for consumer facing marketing content to describe the key features or benefits of the style suitable for display purposes.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Form Description
fields.definition: The physical form or shape of the product. Used, for example, in pharmaceutical industry to indicate the formulation of the product. Defines the form the product takes and is distinct from the form of the packaging.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product ID
fields.definition: Additional means to the Global Trade Item Number to identify a product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Marketing Message
fields.definition: Marketing message associated with the product. Consumer-friendly marketing detailed description of the product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Name
fields.definition: Consumer friendly short description of the product suitable for compact presentation.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Product Range
fields.definition: A name, used by a Brand Owner, that span multiple consumer categories or uses. E.g. (Waist Watchers).
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Sustainability and recycling (deprecated)
fields.definition: This term has been deprecated. Please use gs1:sustainabilityInfo instead.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Production Date
fields.definition: The production date is the production or assembly date determined by the manufacturer. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Production Date and Time
fields.definition: The date and time of production (or assembly). The date and time of production is determined by the manufacturer. The date and time may refer to the trade item itself or to the items contained.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Production Variant Description
fields.definition: Free text assigned by the manufacturer to describe the production variant. Examples are: package series X, package series Y.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Production Variant Effective Date Time
fields.definition: The start date of a production variant. The variant applies to products having a date mark (a best before date or expiration date) on the package that comes on or after the effective date.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Provenance Statement
fields.definition: Free text description of the region or place the product originates from. This is to be specifically used to specify areas such as cities, mountain ranges, regions. Examples: Made in the Thuringen Mountains, Made in Paris, From the Napa Valley.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Referenced File
fields.definition: Link to a file or website containing additional information on product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Regulated Product Name
fields.definition: The prescribed, regulated or generic product name or denomination that describes the true nature of the product. For example for a food product in order to distinguish it from other foods according to country specific regulations.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Replaced By Product
fields.definition: The product which permanently replaces the current product. This product is sent in the record for the original item that is being replaced.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Replaced Product
fields.definition: Indicates the product identification of an item that is being permanently replaced by this product.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Sell By Date
fields.definition: The date specified by the manufacturer as the last date the retailer is to offer the product for sale to the consumer. The product should not be merchandised after this date.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Size Code
fields.definition: Links a product to one or more groupings of gs1:SizeCodeDetails representing the size value from a specified code list.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Supplier Specified Minimum Consumer Storage Days
fields.definition: Represents the number of days between a product's sell by date and its use by date.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Has Target Market
fields.definition: Relates to a set of target market details (product release date and associated countries)
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Variant Description
fields.definition: Free text field used to identify the variant of the product. Variants are the distinguishing characteristics that differentiate products with the same brand and size including such things as the particular flavour, fragrance, taste.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.

fields.label: Warning Copy Description
fields.definition: Warning information is additional information that outlines special requirements, warning and caution information printed on the package.
fields.tier_rationale: GS1 master data is the information on the package.
